cohort: The study included patients diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) from an audit in 2019, an internal cohort from 2021, and an external validation cohort from a separate hospital.
finding: The study developed and validated a pragmatic tool using fasting blood glucose, booking BMI, and gestational weeks at diagnosis to stratify patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) for their likelihood of requiring insulin treatment.
